research_topic: MCP Servers for Tribunus Compute Kernel Bootstrapping on Apple Silicon
transcript_summary: The user requested deep research into MCP servers that can be installed locally to help bootstrap the Tribunus Compute Kernel. The Tribunus Compute Kernel (packages/compute-native/) is a Rust-based MLX inference engine targeting Apple Silicon M1 for Gemma-4-12B model inference. It involves: model acquisition (safetensors from HuggingFace), compilation (Cargo, CoreML MIL builder, ObjC++ bridge), Metal GPU profiling/optimization, NEON CPU benchmarking, DuckDB evidence analytics, and controlled experiment orchestration. The research spanned MCP server registries (Glama.ai ~22K servers, Smithery.ai ~7K servers, mcp.so ~22K servers) and GitHub to find servers in six categories: model acquisition, hardware monitoring, build/profiling, Metal/GPU/MLX, analytics/evidence, and infrastructure/containers.

research_findings.title: Model Acquisition: HuggingFace + safetensors MCP servers exist
research_findings.finding: The official HuggingFace MCP Server (github.com/huggingface/mcp-server) allows AI assistants to search models, datasets, and Spaces on the Hub with metadata. The ComfyUI MCP Server can directly download safetensors files and place them in specified directories. However, no dedicated 'download and verify safetensors to a local path' MCP server exists for the Tribunus kernel's specific need of acquiring Gemma-4-12B MLX weights. The best approach is using the HuggingFace MCP Server for discovery + huggingface_hub Python library for download within a custom MCP tool.

research_findings.title: Hardware Monitoring: CLI tools dominate, MCP wrappers emerging
research_findings.finding: For Apple Silicon real-time monitoring, CLI tools macmon (no sudo, HTTP endpoint) and asitop (sudo, powermetrics wrapper) are mature but not MCP-native. The Jungle Grid MCP Server on Glama enables GPU workload submission/monitoring via MCP. Feluda.ai offers a unified macOS MCP server with native Apple Silicon support bundling multiple tools. No MCP server exists that wraps macmon/powermetrics for GPU/ANE utilization streaming, but building one is straightforward given macmon's HTTP metrics endpoint.

research_findings.title: Build & Profiling: cargo-mcp and Xcode MCP servers available
research_findings.finding: cargo-mcp (on Glama) exposes cargo operations including cargo_bench for Rust build/benchmark orchestration. This directly applies to Tribunus's Cargo-based build system with custom profiles (image-build, inference-research, etc.). The Xcode MCP Server (Glama + Xcode 26.3 built-in) can build/test macOS projects, relevant for the ObjC++ bridge compilation via cc crate. XcodeBuildMCP proxies Xcode's internal MCP. The Instruments Profiling Skill on Smithery wraps xctrace for macOS performance profiling. Pprof Analyzer MCP generates flamegraphs from Go profiles — the concept maps to Rust but the tool doesn't.

research_findings.title: Metal/GPU/MLX: Metal Shader Expert skill + inference servers exist
research_findings.finding: The Metal Shader Expert skill on Smithery covers MSL development, GPU optimization, compute shaders, ray tracing on Apple Silicon, and GPU profiling/debugging — directly relevant to Tribunus's Metal megakernels and GPU profiling. MLX-based inference servers (mlx-serve, vllm-mlx, oMLX, MLX Manager) expose OpenAI-compatible APIs and could be wrapped as MCP servers for the inference verification pipeline. No dedicated MLX MCP server exists yet, but vllm-mlx (Apple Silicon, paged KV cache, multimodal) is the closest match and could be extended with MCP tooling.

research_findings.title: Analytics/Evidence: DuckDB MCP servers mature and well-integrated
research_findings.finding: Three DuckDB MCP servers exist: ktanaka101/mcp-server-duckdb (Python, basic LLM integration), duckdb-mcp by Inxo (Go, SELECT/DDL/DML with env config), and the duckdb_mcp community extension (dual-mode client+server, stdio/TCP/WebSocket). The structured.sh memory MCP uses DuckDB WASM + Parquet for persistent agent memory. These directly address the evidence pipeline: Tribunus emits NDJSON research traces that land in DuckDB via Apache Arrow batches. An MCP-wrapped DuckDB would let AI agents query benchmark results, optimization records, and experiment outcomes conversationally.

research_findings.title: Infrastructure: GitHub MCP + Apple Containers MCP
research_findings.finding: The official GitHub MCP Server enables repo management, PRs, issues, and code analysis — useful for the mlx-rs-fork management and Tribunus monorepo CI. ACMS (Apple Container MCP Server) provides 50+ container operations via macOS container CLI, useful for isolated build environments. The GitHub MCP Server for Apple Containers (transcendr) provides native ARM64 execution without Docker Desktop overhead.
